title: Development of a novel PKC ligand using machine learning model: synthesis and PKC surrogate binding of the simplified analogues of alotaketals
authors: Jumpei Maki; Asami Oshimura; Chihiro Tsukano; Ryo Yanagita; Yutaka Saito; Yasubumi Sakakibara; Kazuhiro Irie
one_liner_zh: 该文利用机器学习与分子模拟设计PKC配体并研究其与PKC结构域的相互作用，对象为蛋白质-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: We have designed and synthesized a new PKC ligand with a novel skeleton based on alotaketals through in silico screening, docking analysis, and molecular dynamics simulation. We found that the new ligand has a higher affinity for PKCα-C1A than for PKCδ-C1B. This compound is expected to serve as the basis for developing PKC ligands with isozyme selectivity.
abstract_zh: 我们通过计算机模拟筛选、对接分析和分子动力学模拟，设计并合成了一种基于alotaketals的新型骨架PKC配体。我们发现，该新配体对PKCα-C1A的亲和力高于对PKCδ-C1B的亲和力。该化合物有望作为开发具有同工酶选择性的PKC配体的基础。
